g.desc: The SPF algorithm: 1. Finds all subnets inside the area based...
g.text: The SPF algorithm:1. Finds all subnets inside the area based on LSAs Type 1 and 2.2. Analyzes the LSDB to find all possible routes to every subnet.3. Picks the route with the lowest total cost and updates the route table.
